html:
Are you wondering what’s beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in December, the climate and entertainment areas, or what’s fun about the scenic spots? So to meet that expectation, Vietlook Travel will share with you the experience of traveling to Ha Long in December, what’s beautiful right in this article.

Ha Long, which owns islands, towering mountains or long, poetic beaches with many beautiful landscapes, is a stopover chosen by many tourists during each of their vacations, especially here there are many caves such as: Trinh Nu Cave, Dau Go Cave, Sung Sot Cave… will bring tourists the most enjoyable vacation.

Ha Long climate in December

In December, Ha Long begins to enter winter, the temperature is around 20 degrees Celsius, the morning is chilly, the afternoon is sunny, the evening is chilly. If you travel Ha Long in December, you should not participate in water games.

When traveling to Ha Long in winter, you should sip a cup of coffee and admire the poetic scenery of the sea and islands. This is the time for those who do not like the hustle and bustle of the bustling city, and is very suitable for resort tours in Ha Long.

Places not to be missed when traveling to Ha Long in December

Tuan Chau Island Ha Long

A place with its own beauty, in December the island is peaceful, airy, the weather is very nice for visitors to admire the scenery, a peaceful scene, let’s chat with friends and have fun stories together.

In addition, when coming to Tuan Chau, you can also watch water puppetry, enjoy the music, combine with the colorful light space or participate in entertainment programs at Tuan Chau Park with many games suitable for all ages such as: Roller coaster, flying saucer, cable car…

Quang Ninh Museum

A place that preserves historical and cultural values, when coming here, visitors not only visit but also learn about historical and cultural values, and have a space to recreate the daily work of the people here.

Check in Ha Long Old Town

A place with unique architecture, a place where modern and traditional cultures intersect, is a unique check-in spot chosen by many tourists when traveling to Ha Long in December, the most beautiful is early in the morning when the sun has just risen, visitors can take beautiful pictures for themselves.

Ha Long Night Market

Ha Long Night Market, also known as Bai Chay Night Market, is located in the center, so it is very convenient for tourists to come here to visit, shop, and enjoy the delicious dishes of Ha Long.

Bai Chay Bridge – Ha Long

As one of the beautiful bridges connecting Hon Gai and Bai Chay, it is a virtual living spot that many tourists visit, especially when the night falls, the sparkling lights of the city add to the beauty of Ha Long.

Delicious and attractive dishes in Ha Long

White sticky rice with squid sausage is a dish that cannot be missed when going on a tour Ha Long in December, the ingredients are processed very elaborately, the aroma of sticky rice and the sweetness of squid will make visitors remember this delicious flavor forever.

Sea Sam

As a delicious and nutritious dish, sam can be processed into different dishes such as: stir-fried sam cartilage, stir-fried sam with sweet and sour… when enjoying, diners will feel the famous sweet and chewy taste of Ha Long.

Mantis shrimp vermicelli

With pure white vermicelli, mantis shrimp, raw vegetables and broth, in the cold winter weather of Ha Long, enjoying a bowl of hot vermicelli is nothing more interesting.

Ha Long pearl yogurt

Although it is a light dish, when enjoying it, diners will remember its own delicious flavor forever. When you have freely explored, enjoy Pearl yogurt while watching the scenery, visitors will feel more relaxed than ever.

Nodding cake

The name sounds attractive, it is one of the famous snacks in Ha Long, when coming here, visitors can enjoy nodding cake right at the roadside stalls, the cake is made from soft, chewy and pure white flour, bringing an irresistible delicious flavor.

The above are the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in December, hopefully through this article will help you on your trip, wish you the happiest vacation.
